meta.name: replay-user-flows
meta.description: Turn a user journey you just clicked through into a saved regression check that re-runs deterministically, with no model in the loop and no test code to write. Use when you have driven the same flow twice, when the user wants regression coverage without a Playwright suite, when a refactor needs proving against every existing journey, or when re-verifying by hand is costing a full drive every time.

copy.tagline: 把刚走过的操作流程存成可重复运行的回归检查,不用写测试代码。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次改完代码都要把同样几条流程手动再点一遍。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a flow you just clicked through into a repeatable regression check.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you re-click the same few flows after every code change.

howto.what: 它把你刚点过一遍的用户旅程自动保存成流程文件(.reticle/flows/),之后代码有改动时会重放这些流程来验证,不用写测试代码,重放过程也不调用模型。
howto.when: 当你把同一条流程手动走过两遍、想做回归覆盖又不想写 Playwright 套件,或重构后要逐条验证已有旅程时触发。

howto.what_en: It saves the user journey you just clicked through as a flow file in .reticle/flows/, then replays those flows deterministically to verify later changes. No test code to write, no model in the replay loop.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you have driven the same flow twice, want regression coverage without a Playwright suite, or a refactor needs proving against every existing journey.

say_en.note: Only flows touching those files re-run.
One call replays every saved flow.

say_en.note: Lists recorded flows with no assertions.
